verdict.rationale: Convex documents its own scheduler for running background workflows, plus crons and code-defined HTTP endpoints via httpAction, so developers can write code that kicks off actions automatically. However, nothing in the pack documents event-driven rules such as database triggers or on-write hooks. Crons are time-based recurring schedules, not event triggers. missing for 10: documented event-triggered rules (e.g., triggers on document changes), docs showing the scheduler invoked from events, a declarative rule definition surface, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Convex also includes a scheduler for running background workflows
Database, functions, workflow, sync, search, file storage, and more.
HTTP endpoints are defined in `convex/http.ts` and require an `httpAction` decorator.
